RUS.scope: Russian Federation federal budget expenditure, 1996 federal budget law (No. 228-FZ): revenue 347.2tn and expenditure 435.75tn rubles, deficit 88.55tn; 5000 rubles per US$. Line split below the law's headline totals is estimated.

exps.name: National defense
exps.note: Defense allotment of 78.9tn rubles (about 18% of expenditure): personnel, procurement, R&D, construction; sharply under-funded in execution.

exps.name: Law enforcement and state security
exps.note: Interior troops, police, courts, security services and border guards. Estimated.

exps.name: Public debt service
exps.note: Interest on domestic GKO/OFZ and external debt (Paris/London Club, Soviet-era). Estimated.

exps.name: National economy and federal investment program
exps.note: Federal investment program 29.2tn (agro-industrial 1.6, fuel and energy 0.9, transport 1.2) plus industry, agriculture, transport subsidies. Estimated.

exps.name: Fundamental research and scientific-technical progress
exps.note: Appendix 2 of the 1996 budget law, 11,565bn rubles.

exps.name: Health and physical culture
exps.note: Federal health spending (most paid via regions and compulsory insurance). Estimated.

exps.name: Social policy and pensions support
exps.note: Federal social support, Pension Fund top-ups, benefits. Estimated.

exps.name: Culture, art, media
exps.note: Cultural heritage 1.7tn (Appendix 4), TV and radio 2.14tn (Appendix 3), other culture. Estimated.

exps.name: Transfers to regions
exps.note: Fund for Financial Support of Regions and other transfers to subjects of the Federation. Estimated.

exps.name: Government administration
exps.note: Federal bodies, legislature and executive. Estimated.

exps.name: International activity and CIS loans
exps.note: Foreign aid, loans to CIS states (200bn limit), international organizations. Estimated.

exps.name: Other expenditure and reserves
exps.note: Residual to the law's 435.75tn total: reserve fund, disasters, other.
